title: Amelia & James
intro: Your wedding selection, edited and ready to relive. Take your time with these twelve frames — they are the story of the day as it actually happened, in the order it unfolded.
howTo: Star the frames you love as you go. Favourites are saved on this device, so you can come back tomorrow and keep choosing — then export the list and send it back with your reply.
usageNote: These photographs are delivered for your personal use — share them with family and print them for your walls. For album design, retouching, or additional prints, mention the filename and Mara will take it from there.

faqs.question: How do favourites work?
faqs.answer: Select the star on any photograph to mark it as a favourite, and select it again to remove it. Favourites are saved in this browser on this device, so they will still be here when you come back later. Choosing on a different device starts a fresh list.

faqs.question: How do I send my favourites back?
faqs.answer: Press “Export list” in the tray at the bottom of the page. It downloads a small CSV file naming each starred photograph — attach it to your reply and Mara will start the edit conversation from exactly those frames.

faqs.question: Do I have to choose everything in one sitting?
faqs.answer: No. Star a few frames now, close the page, and return whenever you like — your selection will be waiting on this device. Export whenever the list feels right; you can export as many times as you want.

faqs.question: Can I print these photos or post them online?
faqs.answer: Yes — this gallery is delivered for your personal use, so share, post, and print freely. A quiet credit is always appreciated but never required. The photographs may not be resold or entered into competitions without written permission.
